messages:
maya: FYI Marketplace reported failures on our ROCm images for V1 models on MI250 nodes after latest kernel + rocm5.7. Symptoms: OOM in quant kernel and occasional hangs.
tom: Can you paste the node logs? Which image tag?
maya: Example error: ```E rocm_quant: alloc_failed size=4194304 at step=1024
RuntimeError: Out of GPU memory during kernel launch``` Seen on image: redwood/rlruntime:rocm5.7-kernel-6.5.0-4.
rachel: This looks different from earlier CUDA regressions. Could be ROCm allocator behavior with our continuous batching. Simon, any recent changes in KV caching that might increase peak allocation?
simon: Not on our side. We shipped a small batching tweak last week but it reduced peak mem in local tests. Vendor note might be upstream allocator fragmentation. I'll repro locally on an MI250 canary.
vendor-amd-bot: AMD advisory: We're aware of an allocation regression introduced in ROCm 5.7 on certain kernels. Hotfix candidate 5.7.1 being validated. Provisional mitigation: use ROCm 5.6.2 kernel images or enable early free of KV caches. ETA for 5.7.1 validation: 36-48 hours.
maya: Marketplace approval path: can we publish a minor image update that pins ROCm to 5.6.2? Jordan (cc'ed in channel) handled AWS/Azure flows before.
tom: Short-term plan: 1) create marketplace canary image pinned to rocm5.6.2 + kernel 6.4, 2) add runtime toggle to free KV cache aggressively for quant models, 3) coordinate with SI partners for smoke testing. I'll open infra PR and smoke tests.
rachel: Also add a fallback policy: route affected customers to non-quant model variant automatically if allocation spikes detected. Need to update rollout docs and notify PS.
simon: Repro steps I'm using: ```export RW_TEST_MODE=canary
pytest tests/alloc_regress_test.py::test_mi250_quant -k mi250 -q --maxfail=1``` If anyone wants to reproduce I can provide a small docker compose for MI250 emulator.
vendor-amd-bot: Update: Hotfix build passed internal perf tests. Vendor requests partners perform validation on representative workloads. If you can start validation, we can prioritize marketplace lanes.
maya: Action items: tom create canary image PR & smoke tests (target 4h), simon provide repro artifact and docker-compose (2h), rachel draft partner note & PS runbook (3h). I'll open the marketplace fast-track request and list SI contacts @acme-si @sunrise-intl.
tom: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4988 - includes image tag, smoke tests, and rollback playbook.
maya: I'll ping Marketplace once PR and validation logs are attached. Post status to #marketplace-incidents and include tentative joint announcement hold until vendor confirms hotfix.
rachel: Also schedule a short sync with SIs to run their integration tests tomorrow morning UTC. Who can own invites?
simon: I can own the invite and prep test vectors.
vendor-amd-bot: Hotfix scheduled for partner rollout: ROCm 5.7.1 release candidate available now. Full release pending partner validation.
maya: Thanks everyone. Keep thread updated with validation results. We'll treat this as high priority until all affected customers are back on stable images.
